entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. The present first bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No.110 of 2017, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police station- Babari, District- Shamli, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

The applicant was granted bail in this case by this Court vide order dated 29.06.2017 but later on he has gone to Punjab to earn his livelihood and thus he could not appear before the trial Court and thus, non bailable warrants were issued against him.

It is further submitted that now the applicant is in jail since 29.05.2022 and the trial of the case would Sonu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188379506/
1 take long time.

entities.text: Sonu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was stated that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that during trial, applicant has absconded and he remained absconder for several years.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Sonu, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.3.2024 RKM  Sonu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188379506/
